title: Data for exact completed-coefficient localization and slices
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integers $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every scheme $X$ use $B_X=\varprojlim_n(R/t^{n+1})_X$, its compatible constant scalar map, the sheafified sectionwise localization $A_X=B_X[1/t]$ and its unit [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Use the recorded ordinary module categories and unbounded derived categories on the small pro-etale sites, with the module and localization sizes fixed by [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The coefficient $E$ action on $D(A_X)$ is induced by the inverse of the recorded fraction-normalized isomorphism $R[1/t]\simeq E$ and the constant-section map [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-tw-lisse-localization-interfaces].

Define LocalizationData on $X$ to consist of a universal cochain model for $B_X\to A_X$ [def-sfb-derived-change-of-rings-cochain-model], finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of its specified ordinary extension, a derived comparison with exact termwise extension normalized against its cochain counit, all natural cohomology comparisons, an additive realization of the raw rationalized constructible category with its specified object equality and pure-tensor scalar map formula, and preservation of every localized standard cohomological half [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure].

For any pro-etale object $U\to X$, restriction of modules is literal slice restriction followed by sectionwise pushforward along the recorded slice equivalence, transporting scalars by the inverse of the supplied ring isomorphism [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-tw-lisse-localization-interfaces]. Define SliceCoefficients to consist of the integral, rational and every residue-ring isomorphism on $U$, normalized on all completed projections, constants, localization units and section fractions $b/t^n$. Define SliceTensorCompatibility for a ring sheaf to assert the natural comparison between restriction of its sheaf tensor product and tensor product of restrictions, normalized on each pure tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define modelTensorSection as the sheafification-unit image of an ordinary scalar pure tensor, transported by the cochain model's object equality. Define SliceLocalization for two specified LocalizationData and specified SliceCoefficients to consist of exact additive integral and rational restriction, an ordinary extension/restriction comparison normalized on modelTensorSection, and its derived comparison, whose cochain normalization is precisely the stated equality of the two counit composites. These are data and predicates only; none asserts their existence, and no finite-type assumption is imposed on $U$.
